identity.title: Weather Qualification Data Readiness
identity.objective: Build one bounded, auditable weather qualification-data readiness corpus for the exact PR #200 NON_WALLET daily-rain lineage: verified PR #200 Alpha registry and AF1 receipt, real rain-market/rule/outcome census, provenance-separated PendulumFlow v3 market history (external, never canonical PIT), official historical NDFD PoP12 vintages decoded by a production offline adapter, exact station/spatial/time binding, two fixed checkpoints, factual counts and execution-feasibility facts, sealed as a content-addressed WeatherQualificationDataReadinessBundle with terminal QUAL_DATA_READY or QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT. Data formation only: no QualificationCandidate, gate run, predictive metric, dependency/workflow change, credential, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-QUAL-DATA-01. The three offline src modules, the foreground operator, their focused/contract tests, the compatibility-test production-adapter binding and the docs/status/spec artifacts disappear. Ignored local_data evidence is untouched by revert; dependencies, workflows, qualification contracts and all runtime, order and capital state are unchanged.

api_matrix.reason: No product or trading API is added; the operator consumes the existing verified PolymarketPublicClient.get_market unchanged and public read-only research endpoints only.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules freeze lineage, corpus, checkpoints, windows, source authority, structure, clocks, binding, labels, provenance, identity, counts, execution facts, B0 state, network bounds, finalization, authority and successor boundary.

items.required_rule: prepare discovers alpha_registry.sqlite3 only under git worktree roots, verifies the exact 15-row PR #200 snapshot (candidate/family/episode ids, RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE, head) with the merged registry API, copies and re-verifies it; zero -> ALPHA_LINEAGE_EVIDENCE_MISSING, conflict -> ALPHA_LINEAGE_CONFLICT; never reconstructed.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Committed S10-GATE-AF1 evidence must validate as FINALIZED AF1_PASS with receipt af1gate:sha256:281c5e05f5e4f8e30687f232e0289b99b0719c87fab61c8b1d1d417dc0b5cbb2 and ten PASS dimensions, else AF1_EVIDENCE_DRIFT.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Target dates are exactly 2026-08-18 through 2026-09-26 inclusive (40 dates) with no extension.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: MARKET_OBSERVABLE_PLUS_60M_V1 = max(v3 new_market timestamp_received, trustworthy Gamma open time when present) + 60 minutes.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: TARGET_CLIMATE_DAY_START_V1 = target-date midnight in the rule-bound station's local standard time with the explicit standard UTC offset; eligible only if observably open >= 60 minutes before.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Market-history evidence lookback is exactly 24 hours before each checkpoint.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: NDFD vintage discovery inspects only PoP12 objects with public availability in [checkpoint - 48h, checkpoint].
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: No checkpoint feature evidence may be received or publicly available after the checkpoint; reference/valid time never substitutes availability.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: PendulumFlow v3 is THIRD_PARTY_NATIVE_FRAME_ARCHIVE with b0_source_authority EXTERNAL_THIRD_PARTY_PIT_RECONSTRUCTION; never SOURCE_KIND_CANONICAL_PIT or a DatasetSnapshotReference.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Manifest schema, product byte ranges, row-group bounds and product SHA-256 are validated fail-closed with closed codes.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: timestamp_received (capture availability) and venue timestamp stay distinct; ordering uses timestamp_received; sequence/file order is never claimed as arrival order.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: FULL and SINGLE-BY-DESIGN hours are admissible and the class is preserved in provenance.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: PARTIAL and SINGLE-BY-DEFECT hours are diagnostic/exclusion only with PARTIALLY_OBSERVED and PARTIAL fidelity.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Before ecCodes sees a message: non-empty, GRIB magic, edition 2, section-0 length equals slice length, final 7777; else a closed code.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Multi-message objects are scanned deterministically into single declared messages; ambiguous/truncated structure rejects.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: WMO bulletin time, public availability time (object LastModified bound), GRIB reference time and forecast valid interval are preserved separately.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: ecCodes is lazy-imported only on decode paths; the real run requires Python 3.12 with eccodes==2.48.0 (and eccodeslib==2.48.0.26 off Windows).
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Station id comes from the rule; NWS metadata supplies coordinate/timezone only; standard offset via stdlib zoneinfo; nearest grid via ecCodes; ambiguity excludes.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Rule cohort id is SHA-256 over normalized station/product/threshold/LST/finality semantics; FIRST_PUBLISHED_FINAL, LATEST_BEFORE_2359_ET, LAST_BEFORE_1400_ET only; else RULE_SEMANTICS_UNSUPPORTED.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Labels require v3 market_resolved and Gamma final outcome agreement and stay separate from checkpoint feature evidence.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Ready-subset manifests have dq_flags ('OK',), replay fidelity EXACT or FAITHFUL and empty gap summary; manifests stay <=256 items.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: weatherqualdataset:sha256 and bundle ids are canonical-JSON SHA-256 over committed content and exclude paths, host, wall-clock, latency and retry timing.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Only actual derived counts are reported; no required sample, group, power, MDE or significance threshold is invented.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: FEES, RESOLUTION_RULES and TICK_SIZE_MIN_ORDER per market use HISTORICALLY_EVIDENCED, CURRENT_ONLY, MISSING or SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT; no AVAILABLE is forced.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: b0_contract_compatibility is EXTERNAL_ONLY_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_COMPATIBILITY_DECISION unless canonical PIT is independently bound.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Only the operator touches the network: https GET/HEAD/Range to archive.pendulumflow.com, noaa-ndfd-pds.s3.amazonaws.com, gamma-api.polymarket.com, api.weather.gov; no redirect, auth or arbitrary URL.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: <=40 dates, <=1024 candidates, <=128 stations, <=2000 hours, <=8192 attempts, <=2 GiB bytes, <=256 MiB per response, at most one immediate retry; exhaustion -> QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: run-01 runs once; after a semantic terminal no rerun with changed dates, checkpoints, windows, policy or budgets; verify-final is zero network.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: No QualificationCandidate, qualification gate, WP170/WP172/WP173, credential, scheduler, Hermes, strategy, paper, execution, live, Gate C, capital or order path.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: The successor (S10-QUAL-REAL-01 or a B0 compatibility decision) is separately gated and not authorized; merge not authorized.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

IMPLEMENTATION_READY on governance track RUNTIME with 20 scope files and the exact authority mirror

genuine registry verified by the merged Alpha registry API, copied, re-verified; missing -> ALPHA_LINEAGE_EVIDENCE_MISSING, conflict -> ALPHA_LINEAGE_CONFLICT; no reconstruction
committed AF1 evidence validates as FINALIZED AF1_PASS with the exact receipt id and ten PASS dimensions; drift -> AF1_EVIDENCE_DRIFT
